# `hk util end-of-file-fixer`

- **Usage:** `hk util end-of-file-fixer [-d --diff] [-f --fix] <FILES>…`
- **Effect:** modifies state

Check for and optionally fix missing final newlines

A missing final newline is added as the file's most frequent line ending, so a CRLF file gets CRLF. Every line ending in the file counts, as in `mixed-line-ending`, and a tie gives LF. Trailing blank lines, LF or CRLF, are removed. A file that already ends with exactly one newline is left as it is.

## Arguments

- **`<FILES>…`** — Files to check/fix

## Flags

- **`-d --diff`** — Output a diff of the change. Cannot use with `fix`.
- **`-f --fix`** — Fix files to end with exactly one newline
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Check first, or request an in-place fix explicitly.

```sh
hk util end-of-file-fixer README.md
hk util end-of-file-fixer --fix README.md
```
